name: San Muñoz (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes of white, red and white with a broad red central stripe, charged with the crowned municipal arms of San Muñoz (a black chevron on yellow and a lion on white).
history: The arms of San Muñoz were published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 4 November 1997; the municipal flag was approved on 27 May 1999 and is quadrangular and flanked, with a double-width stripe of gules bearing the arms of the corporation.
